description: Implementation of a short block detector for channel coding, including LUT creation, ML detection algorithms for 2-bit and 3-11 bit messages, and span validation functions.

classes.name: short_block_detector_impl
classes.description: Class implementing short block detection algorithms, including detection for different message lengths.

methods.name: create_lut
methods.description: Creates a lookup table for codewords based on encoding all possible even-valued messages.

methods.name: validate_spans
methods.description: Validates input and output spans for detection, ensuring size constraints and non-zero bits.

methods.name: detect_2
methods.description: Performs ML detection for 2-bit messages using correlation with predefined codeword table.

methods.name: detect_3_11
methods.description: Performs ML detection for messages with length between 3 and 11 bits, using correlation and GLRT.

methods.name: rate_dematch
methods.description: Recovers original short codeblock from rate-matched version by combining and copying LLRs.

methods.name: short_block_detector_impl::detect
methods.description: Main detection function that handles different message lengths and thresholds for detection.
